currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann offene, geschlossene und isolierte Systeme unterscheiden und Energieerhaltung qualitativ erklären.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can distinguish open, closed, and isolated systems and qualitatively explain conservation of energy.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Energieerhaltung mit der tatsächlichen Systemgrenze verbinden; Wärme und Arbeit sind Übertragungsgrößen, innere Energie ist eine Zustandsgröße.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Connect conservation to the actual system boundary; heat and work are transfers, internal energy is a state quantity.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Offenes, geschlossenes und isoliertes System unterscheiden und die Energieflüsse mit konsistenten Vorzeichen erklären.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Distinguish open, closed and isolated systems and explain energy transfers with consistent signs.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Beim offenen Gefäß den Energieinhalt austretender Materie ergänzen; starres Gefäß und Kolbenprozess unter ihren jeweiligen Bedingungen vergleichen.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Include energy carried by escaping matter in an open vessel; compare rigid and piston processes under their respective conditions.

rationale: One coherent conservation and system-boundary competence. System classifications are conditions of its application, not separate unrelated routines. Both complete DE/EN cases and four-point rubrics are sound: 1200-350=850 J; 100 kPa times 2 L gives 200 J expansion work, 300 J internal-energy increase and, under the stated constant-pressure/only-pV assumptions, 500 J enthalpy change. The open-control-volume limitation and constant total U with changing temperature in an isolated reacting system are explicit. Formula provision supports the qualitative goal rather than claiming an additional quantitative source clearance. Native/image judgment: Personally inspected native page 03, exact full PNG and own 360/680 frames. Q/W arrows use the stated positive-in convention; isolated-system arrows are blocked and U is constant. Image is orientation, not exhaustive open-system coverage. Main relation is legible at 360; small annotations are not claimed universally legible. Full goal ID and checked external prerequisite context fit the native page. All author/legacy/AI-V approval metadata excluded; E1/G1 machine candidate only.

currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Reaktionsenthalpien mit dem Satz von Hess und einfachen Kalorimetrieansätzen bestimmen.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can determine reaction enthalpies using Hess's law and simple calorimetry approaches.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Reaktionsenthalpie als Zustandsgrößenänderung aus Hess-Bilanzen und begrenzten kalorimetrischen Messungen bestimmen.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Determine reaction enthalpy as a state change using Hess balances and bounded calorimetric measurements.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Teilreaktionen korrekt umkehren und addieren sowie Wärmebilanz, Stoffmenge, Phasen und Messgrenzen konsistent auswerten.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Reverse and add reaction steps correctly and consistently evaluate heat balance, amount, phases and measurement limits.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Hydratstufe, gasförmige Produkte oder Produktwasserphase verändern und deren Wirkung auf die Bilanz begründen.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Change hydration state, gaseous products or product-water phase and explain their effect on the balance.

rationale: Hess calculation and simple calorimetry are complementary methods of one assessable reaction-enthalpy determination competence; the method conjunction alone does not require a split. All five complete DE/EN cases, data and rubrics inspected. Hess gives -110.5 kJ/mol and -55.25 kJ for 0.5 mol. Salt masses/calorimeter capacity give approximately -66.14 and +19.68 kJ/mol. ST Mg/HCl and ammonium-hydrogencarbonate/HCl equations balance; approximately -456.55/+38.13 kJ/mol follow the supplied synthetic data. Neutralization gives 224.64 J/-56.16 kJ/mol; net water and hydronium notation are distinguished. Gas-phase methane formation/bond calculations give -802.3/-802 kJ/mol. Phases, reaction extent, heat losses and exported gas energy are bounded. Where the source says plan/conduct, actual supervised execution, raw T(t), controls and repeats remain required; synthetic examples do not discharge it. Göttingen methods were inspected directly; the smaller quantities and fixed-mixture neutralization are explicitly author adaptations, not exact reproductions of donor measurements. Native/image judgment: Native page 04, full PNG and own 360/680 frames inspected. Hess arrows are a route sketch without an energy axis; intermediate height is not a quantitative energy assertion. q=mcΔT and approximate -q/n are appropriately an orientation approximation; full cases add calorimeter heat capacity/error limits. Page fits and exact ID/prerequisite and successor links remain present. All author/legacy/AI-V approval metadata excluded; E1/G1 machine candidate only.

currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann den Einfluss der Temperatur auf Reaktionsgeschwindigkeiten mithilfe der Stoßtheorie begründen.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can justify the influence of temperature on reaction rates using collision theory.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Temperaturabhängige Reaktionsgeschwindigkeit mit wirksamen Stößen erklären und die RGT-Regel als begrenzte Faustregel anwenden.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Explain temperature-dependent rates through effective collisions and apply RGT as a bounded rule of thumb.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Ratenfaktoren aus Daten ermitteln, energetische und räumliche Stoßbedingungen erklären und einen Mechanismuswechsel erkennen.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Determine rate factors from data, explain energy/orientation collision conditions and identify a mechanism change.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Ausfall eines Katalysators und gasvolumetrische Messbedingungen gegen eine bloße Temperaturfaktor-Extrapolation prüfen.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Check catalyst failure and gas-volume measurement conditions against simple temperature-factor extrapolation.

rationale: One temperature-rate explanation/application competence; collision theory supplies its mechanism. Three complete DE/EN cases inspected: factors 2.5/6.25; unchanged-mechanism prediction 0.1352 versus observed 0.012 demonstrates a failed assumption; supplied Mg/HCl early slopes 0.2/0.4/0.8 mL/s give 2x/4x. Gas temperature/pressure, oxide/surface, self-heating, controls, actual raw runs and repeats are required for the experiment. The NI whole temperature/pressure/concentration/catalyst operator was read separately; this temperature component does not clear its other factors or technique/research partners. Native/image judgment: Native page 05, corrected full PNG and own frames inspected. Both panels contain five A and five B particles; temperatures differ by 10 K, movement/effective-collision indications change and the activation threshold is not claimed to change. Caption's often two-to-three example is bounded and is compatible with the wider ordinary RGT range. No universal exact factor claim. All author/legacy/AI-V approval metadata excluded; E1/G1 machine candidate only.

currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Entropiebeiträge diskutieren und mithilfe der Gibbs-Helmholtz-Gleichung Aussagen zur Spontanität treffen.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can discuss entropy contributions and make statements about spontaneity using the Gibbs-Helmholtz equation.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: System- und Umgebungsentropie gemeinsam betrachten und mit der freien Enthalpie thermodynamische Richtung von Geschwindigkeit unterscheiden.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Consider system and surroundings entropy together and use Gibbs energy to distinguish thermodynamic direction from speed.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Entropiebeiträge einschließlich endothermer Gegenfälle begründen und unter angegebenen T,p-Bedingungen mit ΔG prüfen.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Explain entropy contributions including endothermic contrasts and check them using ΔG under stated T,p conditions.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Lokale Entropieabnahme, statistische Modellgrenzen und tatsächlichen endothermen Lösungsvorgang voneinander abgrenzen.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Distinguish local entropy decrease, statistical model limits and an actual endothermic dissolution.

rationale: The entropy/free-energy combination is one thermodynamic driving-force judgment. No goal-text split or rewrite is required by this image hold. All three complete DE/EN cases inspected. Freezing model: total entropy +1.08/-1.31 J/K and Gibbs -280/+380 J at 260/290 K. Four-particle box model has 1/4/6/4/1 multiplicities, 6/16=0.375 and kB ln6 about 2.474e-23 J/K; not a molar reaction entropy. Endothermic model gives surroundings -67.13, total +12.87 J/(mol K) and -3772 J/mol at 293.15 K. Real dissolution execution/controls/raw data remain necessary and no entropy measurement is claimed. German 'offenes isoliertes Gefäß' is interpretable as thermal insulation from apparatus/English context; 'wärmegedämmt' would be clearer but is not a separate science blocker. Native/image judgment: Exact original native page 06/full JPEG/own 360/680 frames inspected, without successor or peer verdicts. Original caption labels a spontaneous process as generic 'Energie wird frei'; no free-energy qualifier or fixed T,p model condition accompanies it, inviting the false exothermic/spontaneous equivalence that the actual endothermic cases explicitly test. The entropy illustration changes four same particles into six plus two different symbols while changing volume and ordering, with no declared model assumptions: it cannot isolate configurational entropy through visible disorder. Retain goal and P body; correct/qualify the image and obtain fresh bindings before current-page acceptance. All author/legacy/AI-V approval metadata excluded; E1/G1 machine candidate only.

currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann mithilfe der Gibbs-Helmholtz-Gleichung die freie Reaktionsenthalpie berechnen, den Einfluss von Enthalpie- und Entropieänderungen auf die Richtung chemischer Reaktionen bestimmen und Vorhersagen zur Freiwilligkeit sowie zur Möglichkeit einer Gleichgewichtseinstellung treffen.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can use the Gibbs-Helmholtz equation to calculate Gibbs free energy, determine the influence of enthalpy and entropy changes on the direction of chemical reactions, and predict spontaneity as well as the possibility of equilibrium establishment.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Freie Reaktionsenthalpie mit konsistenten Einheiten, Zuständen und Zusammensetzung berechnen und thermodynamische Richtung/Gleichgewicht von Kinetik trennen.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Calculate reaction Gibbs energy with consistent units, states and composition, separating thermodynamic direction/equilibrium from kinetics.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: ΔH−TΔS, Standardbildungsgrößen und redoxbezogene Arbeitsbilanz auswerten; ΔG° nicht mit tatsächlichem ΔG gleichsetzen.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Evaluate ΔH−TΔS, standard formation values and a redox work balance; do not identify ΔG° with actual ΔG.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Temperatur, Reaktionsquotient, Phase und Reaktionsfortschritt variieren und die Gültigkeitsbedingungen der Vorhersage benennen.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Vary temperature, reaction quotient, phase and reaction extent and state prediction conditions.

rationale: Calculation plus interpretation of direction/equilibrium is a single quantitative Gibbs competence, rather than independent unrelated routines. All four complete DE/EN cases inspected: carbonate model +130.4114/-14.54 kJ/mol and about 1109.52 K; A/B model K about 5.67 and actual Gibbs +7.11 kJ/mol at Q=100; methane formation Gibbs -817.8 kJ/mol and -204.45 kJ for extent 0.25 mol; reversible redox -212.267 kJ/mol, work 2122.67 versus loaded 1640.245 J and dissipation 482.425 J. Formula, standard/current composition, kinetics and irreversible-work qualifications are sound. These are synthetic calculations, not experimental derivation. Accordingly the fifth NW source addition remains held even though the canonical computational profile is sufficient. Native/image judgment: Native page 07/full JPEG/own frames inspected. Worked -40−298(-0.100)=-10.2 kJ/mol and threshold 400 K are correct. ΔG is shown without a standard-state superscript; the zero criterion is read as actual reaction Gibbs at the considered states, not a claim that ΔG°=0 at arbitrary composition. Full profile explicitly supplies the necessary standard/composition and constant-H/S model limits. Text and formula remain unclipped. All author/legacy/AI-V approval metadata excluded; E1/G1 machine candidate only.

currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann einfache statistische Verteilungen zur Energetik einordnen.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can classify simple statistical distributions regarding energetics.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Statistische Energieverteilung über normierte Flächen und eine Aktivierungsgrenze interpretieren.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Interpret a statistical energy distribution through normalized areas and an activation threshold.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Kurvenmaximum, Breite und Anteil oberhalb der Grenze bei veränderter Temperatur richtig vergleichen.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Correctly compare curve peak, width and above-threshold fraction after a temperature change.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Eine abgesenkte katalytische Grenze bei unveränderter Verteilung von Erwärmung unterscheiden und Zusatzbedingungen einer Rate benennen.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Distinguish a lower catalytic threshold with unchanged distribution from heating and identify additional rate conditions.

rationale: One distribution interpretation competence. The concise descriptor is made assessable by the complete bound plots/CSV and transfer profile, not by changing its scope. Both whole bilingual cases, all four actual DE/EN plot PNGs and the bound normalized-data/model formula inspected. Epeak=RT/2 gives 1.2471/1.8707 kJ/mol. Normalized tail fractions 0.00729/0.04563 and about 6.26 are consistent with the Maxwell-Boltzmann energy model; catalysis changes the threshold/path, not the distribution or equilibrium. Tasks distinguish area from height and include orientation/concentration/mechanism limits. The decorative primary sketch is not used as a numerical particle histogram or CSV substitute. Native/image judgment: Native page 08/full JPEG/own frames inspected. Cooler sketch is narrower/higher and hotter sketch broader/right-shifted/lower. Unscaled decorative particles are treated as a conceptual sketch, not a quantitative equal-area proof; precise actual normalized plots supply that evidence. Main motif/axes are visible at 360 and native ID/context fit. All author/legacy/AI-V approval metadata excluded; E1/G1 machine candidate only.

currentTitleDe: Grenzen der Umwandlung von Wärme in Arbeit erklären
currentTitleEn: Explain limits of converting heat into work
currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die Grenzen der Umwandlung von Wärme in Arbeit bei zyklisch arbeitenden Wärmekraftmaschinen erklären und Alltagsbegriffe wie Energieverbrauch und Energieverlust fachlich deuten.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can explain the limits of converting heat into work in cyclic heat engines and scientifically interpret everyday terms such as energy consumption and energy loss.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Die zweite-Hauptsatz-Grenze zyklischer Wärmekraftmaschinen von Energieerhaltung und einmaliger Zustandsänderung unterscheiden.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Distinguish the second-law limit for cyclic heat engines from energy conservation and a one-time state change.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Zykluswärme, Arbeit und Abwärme bilanzieren und Energieverlust als verminderte Nutzbarkeit erklären.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Balance cycle heat, work and rejected heat and explain energy loss as reduced usefulness.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Einmalige reversible Expansion und erforderliche Rücksetzung sowie den Arbeitsbedarf eines Kühlschranks vergleichen.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Compare a one-time reversible expansion and required reset, and a refrigerator's work requirement.

rationale: Everyday terminology is interpretation of the same cyclic heat-work limit, not an extra independent goal. Both whole bilingual cases inspected: 700 J rejected heat, reservoir entropy +0.333 J/K; single-reservoir claim would have -2 J/K. Reversible expansion yields about 1728.85 J and 5.763 J/K; changed gas state prevents calling it a cycle and reset cancels net work. Kelvin-Planck is correctly restricted to a full cycle and no energy destruction is inferred. Native/image judgment: Native page 09/corrected full PNG/own frames inspected. Cycle is explicit, warm and cold reservoirs have correctly directed arrows; Qin=W+Qout, no 100% in a cycle and conserved energy are coherent. No blanket prohibition of a one-time heat-to-work conversion. All author/legacy/AI-V approval metadata excluded; E1/G1 machine candidate only.

currentTitleDe: Entropieänderungen aus Energie- und Teilchenverteilung abschätzen
currentTitleEn: Estimate entropy changes from energy and particle distribution
currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Entropie als Maß für die Verteilung von Energie und Teilchen nutzen und Entropieänderungen bei ausgewählten chemischen Reaktionen qualitativ abschätzen.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can use entropy as a measure of energy and particle distribution and qualitatively estimate entropy changes for selected chemical reactions.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Entropieänderungen aus zugänglichen Energie- und Teilchenverteilungen begründet abschätzen, ohne sichtbare Unordnung mit Gesamtspontanität gleichzusetzen.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Estimate entropy changes from accessible energy/particle distributions without identifying visual disorder with overall spontaneity.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Phasen, Gasbildung, Hydratation und stöchiometrische Standardentropiebilanzen unter ihren Bedingungen vergleichen.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Compare phases, gas formation, hydration and stoichiometric standard-entropy balances under their conditions.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Ein positives System-ΔS durch den negativen Umgebungsbeitrag oder durch Hydratation begrenzen und ein tatsächliches endothermes Beispiel korrekt deuten.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Bound positive system ΔS using the negative surroundings contribution or hydration and interpret an actual endothermic example correctly.

rationale: Qualitative estimation and use of distribution models are one competence. Quantitative/source-specific extensions in the profile do not change the common canonical qualitative core. All four complete DE/EN cases inspected. Four-particle 6-versus-1 model, physical vaporization versus carbonate reaction, standard entropy 160.7 J/(mol K)/32.14 J/K at 0.2 mol, and total entropy -437.62 J/(mol K) at 298 K are coherent. Dissolution +20 kJ with +80 J/K gives total +13.33 J/K; hydration limitations are explicit. Actual endothermic experiment is required where BB/BE operator demands it, and the +12.87 J/K/-3772 J/mol model is distinctly synthetic rather than an entropy measurement. Native/image judgment: Native page 10/corrected full PNG/own frames inspected. Two NO2 gas molecules become one N2O4 molecule; N/O counts remain 2/4 and the central connection is interpreted as a shaded ball-and-stick rod, not an asserted Lewis bond-order diagram. Negative standard entropy is correctly qualified as this example at 25 °C, not a universal gas-count or spontaneity rule. Core molecule/formula/count labels are legible in own mobile frame. All author/legacy/AI-V approval metadata excluded; E1/G1 machine candidate only.

currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann mit der Gibbs-Helmholtz-Gleichung qualitativ abschätzen, wie Enthalpie- und Entropieänderungen den freiwilligen Ablauf chemischer Reaktionen beeinflussen.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can use the Gibbs-Helmholtz equation qualitatively to estimate how enthalpy and entropy changes influence the spontaneous course of chemical reactions.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Enthalpie- und Entropieterm bei positiver Kelvin-Temperatur gegeneinander abwägen und thermodynamische Richtung von Geschwindigkeit und Umsatz trennen.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Weigh enthalpy and entropy terms at positive kelvin temperature and distinguish thermodynamic direction from speed and extent.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Alle vier Vorzeichenkombinationen erklären und die Temperaturwirkung bei konkurrierenden Termen begründen.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Explain all four sign combinations and temperature effects when terms compete.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Endotherme/exotherme Lösung, Metastabilität, homogene/heterogene Katalyse und unvollständigen Gleichgewichtsumsatz beurteilen.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Assess endothermic/exothermic dissolution, metastability, homogeneous/heterogeneous catalysis and incomplete equilibrium conversion.

rationale: One qualitative thermodynamic direction judgment; explanatory contrasts test its limits. All three full bilingual cases inspected. Four signs are correct under fixed states and approximately constant H/S; dissolution gives -3/+3 kJ/mol and +10/-10 J/K at 300 K. Synthetic A/B -4.30 kJ/mol is consistent with K about 5.67 and about 85% B. Catalyst phase distinctions, equal endpoint/different times, metastability and ΔG° versus actual ΔG prevent claiming immediate complete conversion. Native/image judgment: Native page 11/full JPEG/own frames inspected. Formula, heat arrows and four sign/temperature cases are correct for actual considered ΔG. 'Always/never' is restricted by the displayed sign assumptions and complete profile's fixed-state/constant-H/S model; it is not used as a claim of rapid or complete reaction. Disorder cubes are conceptual mnemonics rather than quantitative entropy measurements. Main formula/motif is readable at 360; dense small text remains a native/full-size aid. All author/legacy/AI-V approval metadata excluded; E1/G1 machine candidate only.

currentTitleDe: Energetische Kopplung endergoner und exergoner Reaktionen erklären
currentTitleEn: Explain energetic coupling of endergonic and exergonic reactions
currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die energetische Kopplung einer endergonen mit einer exergonen Reaktion erklären und auftretende Energieunterschiede als Entropieerzeugung interpretieren.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can explain the energetic coupling of an endergonic reaction with an exergonic reaction and interpret occurring energy differences as entropy production.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Endergone und exergone Schritte durch einen gemeinsamen chemischen Weg koppeln und die vollständige freie-Energie-/Entropiebilanz unter angegebenen Bedingungen erklären.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Couple endergonic/exergonic steps through a shared chemical pathway and explain the complete free-energy/entropy balance under stated conditions.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Gemeinsames Zwischenprodukt oder direkte Gruppenübertragung zeigen, Reaktionen addieren und Dissipation mit T und vollständiger Systembilanz deuten.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Show a shared intermediate or direct group transfer, add reactions and interpret dissipation using T and a complete system balance.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Getrennte ATP-Hydrolyse von mechanistischer Kopplung unterscheiden und offene Zellsysteme von vollständigen isothermen Aufgabenmodellen abgrenzen.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Distinguish separate ATP hydrolysis from mechanistic coupling and open cells from complete isothermal task models.

rationale: Coupling and entropy production are explanation of one complete thermodynamic process, not two unrelated routines. The native hold requires image repair, not a goal-body rewrite. Both whole bilingual cases inspected. A-P intermediate is actually consumed by the second step, so the -15 kJ/mol/50 J/(mol K) balance is genuine modeled coupling rather than arbitrary summation. Hexokinase direct ATP-to-glucose phosphate transfer is grounded in the named RCSB mechanism; synthetic +14/-31 gives -17 kJ/mol and 54.84 J/(mol K) only under full isothermal/isobaric/no-other-work assumptions. Open cell concentrations/matter/work flows and lack of personal laboratory evidence are explicit. No error requires changing these profiles. Native/image judgment: Native page 12/full JPEG/own 360/680 frames inspected. Literal final balance says released energy is greater than required energy 'plus die Entropieerzeugung'. It adds unlike dimensions (J and J/K) without T and describes strict greater-than where a complete no-other-work balance uses the dissipation term T·Sgen. Middle caption also conflates entropy production with disorder/heat without the full-system condition. This directly undermines the dimensional and conditional distinction tested by the two correct cases. Correct this specific balance/qualification and rebind the actual image/native tuple. Mechanical enzyme imagery alone is an orientation metaphor and is not a separate unsupported stoichiometric fault. All author/legacy/AI-V approval metadata excluded; E1/G1 machine candidate only.

currentTitleDe: Brennwert und Heizwert von Energieträgern erläutern
currentTitleEn: Explain gross and net calorific values of energy carriers
currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Brennwert und Heizwert als energetische Kenngrößen von Brennstoffen erklären, vergleichen und für die Bewertung ausgewählter Energieträger nutzen.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can explain gross and net calorific values as energetic indicators of fuels, compare them, and use them to assess selected energy carriers.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Brenn- und Heizwert über die Produktwasserphase erklären und Energieträger auf vergleichbarer Energie- und Bewertungsbasis beurteilen.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Explain gross/net values through product-water phase and assess fuels on comparable energy and evaluation bases.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Molare und massenbezogene Werte, direkte CO2-Masse, Kosten und Wirkungsgradbasis konsistent vergleichen.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Consistently compare molar/mass-based values, direct CO2, cost and efficiency bases.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Reinen Kohlenstoff ohne Produktwasser, trockenen wasserstoffhaltigen Brennstoff und einen Brennwertkessel über 100% auf Heizwertbasis unterscheiden.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Distinguish pure carbon without product water, dry hydrogen-bearing fuel and a condensing boiler over 100% on a net-value basis.

rationale: Explain/compare/evaluate are increasing application demands on one calorific-value competence; the bounded criterion-based fuel assessment does not require a separate unrestricted sustainability goal. Both complete bilingual cases and five-/four-point rubrics inspected. Net values 121/50.125/32.833 MJ/kg, masses 8.26/19.95/30.46 g per MJ and direct CO2 0/54.86/111.68 g follow balanced combustion. Prices are synthetic dossier inputs, not current market quotations. Condensing case gives 104.74% net/94.38% gross with 44 kJ per mol product-water condensation; no conservation violation. Pure-C equal values, dry fuel versus generated water, production/transport/storage and judgment-weight limitations are explicit. Native/image judgment: Native page 13/full JPEG/own frames inspected. Condenser/water-phase and added condensation heat are coherent; gas/oil/dry-wood bars are unscaled qualitative hydrogen-related contrasts. 'Dry wood/less water' is interpreted relative to the displayed hydrogen-rich fuels, not absence of chemically generated water; complete cases explicitly reject that absence inference. Main visual comparison survives 360, with fine text readable in larger/native versions. All author/legacy/AI-V approval metadata excluded; E1/G1 machine candidate only.
